instruction: Enable automatic spell checking in LibreOffice Writer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto spell check. Evaluator checks config for IsSpellAuto=true. Similar complexity - configuration change via UI.

llm_judge_reasons: State extraction is correct: Postconfig reads LibreOffice registry config file where spell check settings are stored
Comparison logic is correct: check_list function properly compiles regex patterns and searches for them line by line

Expected value is correct: Regex pattern '<item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Office.Linguistic/SpellChecking"><prop oor:name="IsSpellAuto" oor:op="fuse"><value>true</value>' correctly identifies the auto spell check setting
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (IsSpellAuto=true)
Practical feasibility: Config file path is standard LibreOffice location, pattern matching is robust
No parameter handling issues: check_list correctly accesses rules parameter directly
